records.originalText: Were I in your position, I would oppose that plan.
records.finalText: Were I in your position, I would oppose that plan.
records.rationale: Natural inverted second conditional about a personal opinion.

records.originalText: Had I realized what you intended, I wouldn't have agreed.
records.finalText: Had I realized what you intended, I wouldn't have agreed.
records.rationale: Natural inverted third conditional about past agreement.

records.originalText: If I were you, I wouldn't do a thing like that.
records.finalText: If I were you, I wouldn't do a thing like that.
records.rationale: Natural second-conditional personal advice construction.

records.originalText: If your child drinks poison, rush him to the hospital.
records.finalText: If your child drinks poison, rush him to the hospital.
records.rationale: Emergency poisoning instructions require verified medical protocol and situation-specific context.

records.originalText: Refer to the Users' Guide if you have any problems.
records.finalText: Refer to the Users' Guide if you have any problems.
records.rationale: Natural conditional reference to an unspecified user guide, not a product claim.

records.originalText: If you have no liking for modern music, you will not enjoy this concert.
records.finalText: If you have no liking for modern music, you will not enjoy this concert.
records.rationale: Natural taste-based conditional prediction about an unspecified concert.

records.originalText: If it were not for your help, I could not succeed.
records.finalText: If it were not for your help, I could not succeed.
records.rationale: Pragmatic repeat of generic help-dependent success already represented in the corpus.

records.originalText: You must work hard if you are to succeed.
records.finalText: You must work hard if you are to succeed.
records.rationale: Natural normative encouragement about effort toward a goal, without a success guarantee.

records.originalText: If you are to realize your dream, you must work harder.
records.finalText: If you are to realize your dream, you must work harder.
records.rationale: Pragmatic near-paraphrase of the preceding effort-to-achieve-a-goal recommendation.

records.originalText: You're playing with fire if you insist on riding your motorcycle without a helmet on.
records.finalText: You're playing with fire if you insist on riding your motorcycle without a helmet on.
records.rationale: Conventional playing-with-fire warning about a familiar safety risk; no hazardous procedure given.

records.originalText: If you had parked your car here, you would have been fined.
records.finalText: If you had parked your car here, you would have been fined.
records.rationale: Natural fictional third-conditional parking outcome, not advice about an actual fine.

records.originalText: Suppose you had ten million yen, what would you do?
records.finalText: Suppose you had ten million yen, what would you do?
records.rationale: Natural imaginative money-availability question without financial recommendations.

records.originalText: If it were not for the air, planes could not fly.
records.finalText: If it were not for the air, planes could not fly.
records.rationale: Basic atmospheric-flight counterfactual in ordinary educational context, not a vehicle-specific technical claim.

records.originalText: If she's not careful she'll tear a ligament doing that.
records.finalText: If she's not careful she'll tear a ligament doing that.
records.rationale: Natural fictional conditional injury warning without diagnosis or treatment instructions.

records.originalText: Correct me if I am wrong.
records.finalText: Correct me if I am wrong.
records.rationale: Conventional polite correct-me-if-I-am-wrong expression.

records.originalText: Please drop it in the mail if it's not out of your way.
records.finalText: Please drop it in the mail if it's not out of your way.
records.rationale: Natural conditional favor request using out of your way.

records.originalText: If you can use this typewriter perfectly in a month, you may keep it.
records.finalText: If you can use this typewriter perfectly in a month, you may keep it.
records.rationale: Natural fictional conditional offer about demonstrating a skill.

records.originalText: If it were not for great books, our lives would be much the poorer.
records.finalText: If it were not for great books, our lives would be much the poorer.
records.rationale: Natural counterfactual evaluative statement about books and cultural richness.

records.originalText: If he wanted to get to London today, he should leave now.
records.finalText: If he wanted to get to London today, he should leave now.
records.rationale: Natural conditional suggestion about a personal departure plan.

records.originalText: I am wondering if you would like to go and see kabuki with me while staying in Japan.
records.finalText: I am wondering if you would like to go and see kabuki with me while staying in Japan.
records.rationale: Natural tentative invitation with a gerund phrase and a cultural activity noun.

records.originalText: If peace cannot be maintained with honor, it is no longer peace.
records.finalText: If peace cannot be maintained with honor, it is no longer peace.
records.rationale: Unexplained absolute honor-versus-peace maxim needs philosophical context and attribution review.

records.originalText: If the brain is dead, we should let the patient die.
records.finalText: If the brain is dead, we should let the patient die.
records.rationale: Unqualified end-of-life directive lacks medical, ethical and jurisdictional context.

records.originalText: If I were to tell him the truth, he would be angry.
records.finalText: If I were to tell him the truth, he would be angry.
records.rationale: Natural hypothetical personal reaction to disclosure.

records.originalText: Excuse me, but do you need any help?
records.finalText: Excuse me, but do you need any help?
records.rationale: Common complete polite offer of assistance.

records.originalText: If we have not covered all the questions you asked, please inform us.
records.finalText: If we have not covered all the questions you asked, please inform us.
records.rationale: Natural formal conditional follow-up about unanswered questions.

records.originalText: If Cleopatra's nose had been shorter, the whole face of the world would have been changed.
records.finalText: If Cleopatra's nose had been shorter, the whole face of the world would have been changed.
records.rationale: Recognizable unattributed historical counterfactual quotation needs source and context review.

records.originalText: If it had not been for your advice, I would have failed in my business.
records.finalText: If it had not been for your advice, I would have failed in my business.
records.rationale: Pragmatic repeat of the selected help/advice-dependent business-failure counterfactual.

records.originalText: To investigate the incident would take us at least three weeks.
records.finalText: To investigate the incident would take us at least three weeks.
records.rationale: Natural infinitive subject and a fictional estimated investigation duration.

records.originalText: If all went according to her plan, she would be in great demand.
records.finalText: If all went according to her plan, she would be in great demand.
records.rationale: Natural scoped conditional prediction with in great demand.

records.originalText: If it were not for the computer, how inconvenient our lives would be!
records.finalText: If it were not for the computer, how inconvenient our lives would be!
records.rationale: Natural hypothetical exclamation evaluating a life without computers.

records.originalText: If you think this is wrong, you must speak out.
records.finalText: If you think this is wrong, you must speak out.
records.rationale: Natural explicit normative invitation to voice disagreement.

records.originalText: We're going to find ourselves in difficulty if we carry on like this.
records.finalText: We're going to find ourselves in difficulty if we carry on like this.
records.rationale: Natural conditional warning about unspecified ongoing behavior, with carry on.

records.originalText: If you eat any cake, I'll whip you.
records.finalText: If you eat any cake, I'll whip you.
records.rationale: Explicit threat of whipping over food is unsuitable general learner content.

records.originalText: You will have to take his place in case he cannot come.
records.finalText: You will have to take his place in case he cannot come.
records.rationale: Natural take-his-place arrangement with an in-case condition.

records.originalText: If he had been honest, they would have employed him.
records.finalText: If he had been honest, they would have employed him.
records.rationale: Natural fictional employment third conditional.

records.originalText: Hey, has this been sitting out on the dinner table all day? It has to go in the refrigerator or it'll go bad.
records.finalText: Hey, has this been sitting out on the dinner table all day? It has to go in the refrigerator or it'll go bad.
records.rationale: Unspecified all-day food-storage safety instruction lacks food, temperature and handling context.

records.originalText: It occurs to me that I may have misunderstood you.
records.finalText: It occurs to me that I may have misunderstood you.
records.rationale: Natural occurs-to-me realization with a modal-perfect complement.

records.originalText: If I had money, I would buy that camera. As it is, I cannot buy it.
records.finalText: If I had money, I would buy that camera. As it is, I cannot buy it.
records.rationale: Coherent counterfactual purchase wish and explicit present contrast.

records.originalText: Without the ozone layer, we would be in danger.
records.finalText: Without the ozone layer, we would be in danger.
records.rationale: Familiar basic atmospheric-protection counterfactual without an asserted quantitative health outcome.

records.originalText: Were it not for your help, I could never succeed.
records.finalText: Were it not for your help, I could never succeed.
records.rationale: Pragmatic repeat of generic help-dependent success despite conditional inversion.

records.originalText: If it had not been for your help, I would certainly have failed.
records.finalText: If it had not been for your help, I would certainly have failed.
records.rationale: Another unqualified help-dependent failure paraphrase with no distinct example context.

records.originalText: Even if you know the truth, you had better pretend otherwise at present.
records.finalText: Even if you know the truth, you had better pretend otherwise at present.
records.rationale: Natural concessive even-if recommendation in fictional dialogue; no real-world deception instruction.

records.originalText: If you had not helped me, I would have failed.
records.finalText: If you had not helped me, I would have failed.
records.rationale: Pragmatic repeat of the same help-prevented-failure counterfactual already represented.

records.originalText: Had it not been for your help, I would have been fired.
records.finalText: Had it not been for your help, I would have been fired.
records.rationale: Natural inverted third conditional with a distinct fictional employment outcome.

records.originalText: If you were in my place, what would you do?
records.finalText: If you were in my place, what would you do?
records.rationale: Natural hypothetical role-reversal question.

records.originalText: If he can do that, I will eat my hat.
records.finalText: If he can do that, I will eat my hat.
records.rationale: Established eat-my-hat idiom expressing disbelief, not a literal eating instruction.

records.originalText: Had we left home at seven, we could have arrived on time.
records.finalText: Had we left home at seven, we could have arrived on time.
records.rationale: Natural inverted third conditional about departure time and arrival.

records.originalText: If you were footing the bill, you wouldn't say that.
records.finalText: If you were footing the bill, you wouldn't say that.
records.rationale: Natural were-footing-the-bill idiom in a hypothetical personal expense scenario.

records.originalText: Should we go to the mall?
records.finalText: Should we go to the mall?
records.rationale: Common suggestion question about an ordinary destination.

records.originalText: A motel is like a hotel only much smaller and is used mostly by people traveling by automobile.
records.finalText: A motel is like a hotel only much smaller and is used mostly by people traveling by automobile.
records.rationale: Rigid motel definition based on size and car travel is insufficiently accurate across lodging types.

records.originalText: Did you start to learn the piano when you were three, like Mozart?
records.finalText: Did you start to learn the piano when you were three, like Mozart?
records.rationale: Specific Mozart starting-age/instrument assertion embedded in the question needs historical verification.

records.originalText: It's about time you were independent of your parents.
records.finalText: It's about time you were independent of your parents.
records.rationale: Natural about-time construction with a past-form subjunctive about independence.

records.originalText: Now that he has graduated, he must become more serious.
records.finalText: Now that he has graduated, he must become more serious.
records.rationale: Natural now-that consequence framed as a personal normative expectation.
